Nasi Kerabu Ayam Percik.note: Fish floss, fish crackers and budu = fish; salted egg = egg; sambal tumis with belacan = crustaceans. Kerisik and coconut gravy are not milk or tree nuts. Stated mildly spicy.

Nasi Kerabu Ikan Goreng.note: Mackerel, fish floss, fish crackers, budu = fish; salted egg; belacan sambal = crustaceans. Mildly spicy.

Nasi Kerabu Daging Bakar.note: Kicap = soy + gluten; fish floss and budu = fish; salted egg. No belacan named (air asam is tamarind + chilli). Air asam with bird's eye chilli, stated spicy = 2.

Nasi Kerabu Sayur.note: Tofu and tempeh = soy. Sambal without belacan, no fish floss, no budu: vegan as tagged. Mildly spicy.

Laksam.note: Rice-flour noodles stated no wheat; mackerel gravy = fish; coconut milk not milk. Sambal cili on the side, no belacan = chilli condiment, 1.

Nasi Dagang Ikan Tongkol.note: Tuna curry = fish; hard-boiled egg. Glutinous rice has no gluten; fenugreek is not a listed allergen. Mildly spicy.

Nasi Dagang Ayam.note: Chicken curry with coconut milk; hard-boiled egg. Mildly spicy.

Nasi Tumpang.note: Omelette = egg; fish floss = fish; prawn curry = crustaceans. Mildly spicy.

Roti Titab.note: White bread = gluten; butter = milk; kaya and half-boiled egg = egg; kicap = soy + gluten. Vegetarian, not vegan.

Ayam Percik.note: Chicken, coconut milk gravy with chilli, lemongrass, garlic, shallot: no listed allergen. Mildly spicy.

Solok Lada.note: Fish paste = fish; grated coconut and coconut milk are not tree nuts or milk. Stated spicy. Sold out in extra.json.

Keropok Lekor.note: Ikan tamban + wheat flour. Chilli sauce on the side, no heat word = 1.

Ikan Kembung Goreng.note: Mackerel with turmeric and salt. No chilli.

Gulai Daging Kawah.note: Beef, kerisik, coconut milk, palm sugar, spices: no listed allergen. Stated mild.

Telur Masin.note: Salted duck egg. Vegetarian, not vegan.

Keropok Keping.note: Fish and sago crackers; sago has no gluten.

Ulam & Sambal Budu.note: Budu = fermented anchovy = fish. Bird's eye chilli, stated spicy.

Akok.note: Duck egg + wheat flour; coconut milk not milk.

Jala Mas.note: Duck egg yolk and sugar syrup only.

Tahi Itik.note: Egg yolk, coconut milk, sugar syrup.

Putu Halba.note: Rice flour, fenugreek, palm sugar, coconut. Tagged vegan.

Pulut Panggang.note: Dried shrimp filling = crustaceans; glutinous rice has no gluten. Stated mildly spicy.

Kuih Campur.note: Union of its four kuih: akok (egg, wheat), jala mas and tahi itik (egg), putu halba (none). Vegetarian.

Set Nasi Kerabu.note: Default components: Nasi Kerabu Ayam Percik (fish, egg, crustaceans) + teh tarik (condensed and evaporated milk).

Kopi O.note: Beans roasted with butter = milk (rule o); vegetarian, not vegan.

Milo Ais.note: Malted chocolate drink (malted barley = gluten); condensed milk.

Air Sirap Selasih.note: Rose syrup; basil seeds are not sesame.

Air Kelapa.note: Coconut water and flesh; coconut is not a tree nut.
